meta.name: firebase-auth-basics
meta.description: Guide for setting up and using Firebase Authentication. Use this skill when the user's app requires user sign-in, user management, or secure data access using auth rules.

howto.what: 它会指导你给应用添加登录功能：配置Firebase的邮箱、Google等登录方式，部署认证设置，并教你用auth规则保护数据。
howto.when: 当你的应用需要用户登录、账号管理，或用安全规则控制数据访问时。

say.text: 怎么给我的应用加Firebase登录？
say.note: 它会给出配置步骤和示例。
它会告诉你配置方法和常见问题。

howto.what_en: It guides you through adding login to your app: configuring Firebase email/Google sign-in, deploying auth settings, and protecting data with auth rules.
howto.when_en: When your app needs user sign-in, account management, or secure data access via auth rules.

say_en.text: How do I add Firebase login to my app?
say_en.note: It provides setup steps and examples.

say_en.text: How do I enable Google Sign-In?
say_en.note: It explains configuration and common pitfalls.

say_en.text: How do I protect data with auth rules?
say_en.note: It shows how to use request.auth.
